_comment: Silero VAD config for the Hey Jero speech pipeline. ONNX, CPU, 16 kHz. Loaded by runtime.py (VADConfig) and eval_gate5.py.
notes: window_size_samples=512 is the native Silero window at 16 kHz (32 ms/frame).
min_silence_duration_ms=400 is the trailing-silence endpoint used after wake/PTT.
max_speech_duration_s=6.0 is the hard cap on a single captured utterance.
speech_pad_ms=200 is kept on each side of the detected speech region.
